about.title: About
brand.guide_positioning_body: This is the task cockpit — left picks the task, center drives execution, right verifies spec, plan, evaluation, and file changes so the agent stays on track.
brand.guide_usage_1: Scope first: pick a task on the left or start a new one, and verify the working directory before sending anything.
brand.guide_usage_2: Then brief: choose an executor and send a clear goal with constraints and acceptance criteria — not a vague prompt.
brand.guide_usage_3: Watch the right pane while it runs: Spec checks understanding, Plan checks route, Goals and Evaluation catch drift, Files shows what actually changed.
brand.guide_usage_4: Titlebar actions are operational: Channels for delivery, Settings and Logs for debugging, pin-to-top for long-running supervision.

intro.aria_label: Workflow modes and main agents introduction
intro.headline: OpenCorvus pipeline at a glance
intro.tagline: Pick a task on the left, or start a new one. The right panel will then track that task's progress through the agents below.
intro.mode.workflow.label: workflow · full pipeline
intro.mode.workflow.desc: Requirements → Design → Architect → Execute → Deliver. Goal-gated, retry/replan-aware. Use for new features and anything that needs review.
intro.mode.build.label: build · direct edit
intro.mode.build.desc: Bypass the pipeline and run the build agent on a single goal. Use for one-shot edits, quick fixes, and Q&A.
intro.agent.orchestrator.desc: Coordinates the run end-to-end: dispatches goals, retries failed ones, replans on root-cause failures, owns the budget.
intro.agent.requirements.desc: Reads the user request and produces a spec — what is being built, who it's for, what acceptance looks like.
intro.agent.design_analyst.desc: Walks the existing codebase and prior art before any code is changed; surfaces conventions, constraints, and reuse opportunities.
intro.agent.architect.desc: Turns the spec + design analysis into a goal graph: what to build, how it depends, what each goal must verify.
intro.agent.build.desc: The hands-on coding agent. Edits files, runs tools, iterates against per-goal acceptance checks inside an isolated worktree.
intro.agent.delivery.desc: Merges goal worktrees back, runs build / test / lint gates, and decides accepted or rejected with evidence.
intro.agent.integrity.desc: Cross-checks the delivery against the original spec — hallucinations, missing goals, and goal-fidelity drift.
intro.hint: Each agent writes its own session card on the left when it runs. Click 🔍 on any card to inspect that session's trace.
